test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper bought 60 pencils at a rate of 4 for Rs. 5 and another 60 pencils at a rate of 2 for Rs. 3. He mixed all the pencils and sold them at a rate of 3 for Rs. 4. Find his gain or loss percentage.
solution:
Calculation:

Cost of one pencil = Rs 5over 4

Cost of 60 pencil = 5over 4 × 60 = Rs 75

Cost of single second-type pencil = Rs 3over 2

Cost of 60 second-type pencil = 3over 2 × 60 = Rs 90

Total cost price = 75 + 90 = Rs 165.

Selling price of one pencil = Rs 4over 3

Total selling price = 4over 3 × 120 = Rs 160

Total loss = 165 - 160 = Rs 5

Loss% = 5over165 × 100 = 31over 33%

∴ The loss incurred is 31over 33%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Average cost price of both pencils = {5over 4} +{3over 2} over 2 = 11over 8 

Selling price of pencils = 4over 3

Loss = 11over 8 - 4over 3 = 1over 24

Loss % = 1over 24 × 8over 11 × 100 = 31over 33%.
